$comment: Starting state and global rules of the economy. refund = share of the cost handed back when a building or road is demolished (rounded down per item). calendar: the clock (scripts/game/clock.js) turns game seconds into a date; tickSeconds is the fixed step the simulation runs at (the clock cuts every frame into steps of this size, so x1, x2 and x4 give the same town). sim: the knobs of scripts/game/sim.js - see the comment next to each in README.md (Economy and simulation). Times are game seconds, `Day` fractions are 0..1 of a day.
